angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Distance learning provides flexibility and convenience for students.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Online education helps people learn new skills and improve their career chances.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first body paragraph focuses on the flexibility and convenience that distance learning offers to students' personal lives and work schedules.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first body paragraph focuses on the flexibility and convenience that distance learning offers to students' personal lives and work schedules.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: The second body paragraph focuses on how distance learning removes geographical barriers, giving students access to a wider range of educational institutions and subjects.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The second body paragraph focuses on how distance learning removes geographical barriers, giving students access to a wider range of educational institutions and subjects.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: Distance learning enhances accessibility by removing geographical and time-based barriers to education.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Distance learning enhances accessibility by removing geographical and time-based barriers to education.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: Distance learning fosters crucial life skills, particularly self-discipline and time management, which are valuable for career development.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: Distance learning fosters crucial life skills, particularly self-discipline and time management, which are valuable for career development.

promptTraps.en: Do not write a general essay about the topic without answering the exact task.
promptTraps.vi: Không viết bài chung chung về chủ đề mà không trả lời đúng yêu cầu của đề.

promptTraps.en: Do not ignore a direct question in the prompt.
promptTraps.vi: Không bỏ qua câu hỏi trực tiếp trong đề.

faq.questionVi: Đề này đang hỏi điều gì?
faq.answerEn: Break the prompt into its direct requirements before choosing ideas.
faq.answerVi: Hãy tách đề thành các yêu cầu trực tiếp trước khi chọn ý.

faq.questionEn: How many main ideas should I use?
faq.questionVi: Tôi nên dùng bao nhiêu ý chính?
faq.answerEn: Use two developed points with explanation and relevant examples.
faq.answerVi: Dùng hai luận điểm được phát triển bằng giải thích và ví dụ phù hợp.

faq.questionEn: Can I use a personal example?
faq.questionVi: Tôi có thể dùng ví dụ cá nhân không?
faq.answerEn: Yes, if it directly supports the point and remains relevant to the prompt.
faq.answerVi: Có, nếu ví dụ trực tiếp hỗ trợ luận điểm và vẫn liên quan đến đề.

faq.answerEn: Avoid memorised general sentences and any idea that does not answer the task.
faq.answerVi: Tránh câu chung học thuộc và mọi ý không trả lời đúng yêu cầu.

modelPlan.focus: Explore the benefits of distance learning in higher education, emphasizing flexibility, accessibility, and career development.
keyArguments: Distance learning offers self-paced learning, accommodating diverse schedules.
It provides access to a wider range of educational materials and global reach.
Enhances career prospects through specialized programs and networking opportunities.
